## Background

I'm from the city of North Salt Lake and have lived in Utah most my life. I served a mission for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day saints from October 2022-2024. I'm in my 2nd semester at BYU studying computer science and minoring in business.

My summer and current job to pay for school has been street performing all around Utah. Find me weekends and evenings on city streets, outside ice cream and shake shops, and at farmers markets.

### Education

- **Computer Science**, Brigham Young University (Graduating 2029)
- **Relevant Coursework**: CS260 (Web development), CS235 (Data structures), Strat490R (Creating Digital Products with AI: Strategy & Prototyping)

### Experience

#### Street Performer
*July 2022 - Present*

- Learn hustle, grit, self-starting, performing, and knowing an audience.
- Average $70/hr over all my time playing
- Play the accordion, foot drum, foot tambourine, and harmonica all at the same time.

### Skills & Interests

**Technical Skills**

**Interests**
- I'm very involved in different spheres. At BYU I'm in the American Folk Ensemble playing accordion and harmonica, a School Jazz Combo playing guitar, and singing in the Men's Chorus. I also have been learning how to dance recently.

### What's Next

I'm very entreprenurial in nature and see myself in founder or product roles in the future, although I also love the technical side of things.
